Who We Are
A student-led operation, working across campuses in Pakistan.

We are university students initiating a major targeted operation against cyber harassment — a clear guide path for what to save, where to report, who to contact, and how to protect your accounts while getting help.

Action Path
Guide Path
  • Step 01

    Save the Evidence

    Keep screenshots, URLs, usernames, dates, phone numbers, emails, and any messages before blocking the harasser.

    ScreenshotsTimestampsUsernames
  • Step 02

    Secure Your Accounts

    Change passwords, enable two factor authentication, review privacy settings, and tell a trusted person what happened.

    Passwords2FAPrivacy
  • Step 03

    Report and Reach Help

    Use official complaint portals, cybercrime helplines, and digital rights support services to move forward safely.

    FIANCCIADRF
  • Awareness

    Community Safety

    Cyber harassment affects mental health, relationships, and digital security. Safety begins with calm documentation.
